instruction: Set Yahoo as the default search engine for my Chrome browser.

metadata.explanation: Task requires setting Yahoo as the default search engine. Uses existing get_default_search_engine getter to retrieve current search engine setting, then match_in_list to check against acceptable Yahoo variations.
metadata.verification: Uses existing Chrome getter functionality. Task maintains same complexity as original - navigate to Chrome settings and change default search engine.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly reads Chrome Preferences file at the right location and extracts the default search engine name from 'default_search_provider_data.template_url_data.short_name'
Metric 'match_in_list' correctly receives rules dict with 'expected' key and performs proper list membership check
Expected values semantically correct: includes multiple acceptable Yahoo variations (Yahoo!, Yahoo, yahoo) to handle different naming conventions
Complete instruction coverage: evaluator verifies that Yahoo is set as default search engine, which is exactly what the instruction requires
Postconfig properly restarts Chrome to ensure settings persistence is verified (not just in-memory state)
Data flow is correct: getter returns string -> metric checks if string is in expected list -> returns 1.0 on match
No edge case issues: handles error fallback (returns 'Google' on error), which will correctly fail evaluation if getter cannot read preferences
